$comment: The TCO profile: sputtered transparent conductive oxide films. Written by scripts/extract_tco_profile.py from config.json and the prompts as they stood; every slot is a verbatim slice of today's prompts, so editing one changes what the model is asked.
name: tco
description_zh: 磁控溅射透明导电氧化物薄膜：靶材、沉积工艺与薄膜的电学、光学性能。

prompt.sample_definition: A sample is a TCO or transparent-electrode film that this paper deposits itself. The other layers of a device -- a perovskite or organic absorber / active layer, charge-transport layers, thin buffer layers (e.g. evaporated MoOx, WOx, NbOy, VOx, or nanoparticle SnO2 / ZnO under an electrode), metal contacts -- are never samples, nor is a whole device, nor a purchased substrate (commercial ITO or FTO glass). When the paper varies only those other layers, the TCO film it deposits is still a single sample. A multilayer transparent electrode (oxide/metal/oxide such as ITO/Ag/ITO or WO3/Ag/WO3) is one film: its thin metal interlayer is part of it, not a metal contact. Changes to the TCO film itself do make separate samples: each deposition condition, each thickness of any of its layers, and each post-treatment (as-deposited, annealed at 150 °C, annealed at 230 °C...) is its own sample. So is each substrate the paper compares the film's properties on (glass vs. a metal foil); the same film merely deposited on a second substrate to characterise it (Si for XRD, a TEM grid) is the same sample.
prompt.field_scope: Every field describes the TCO / transparent-electrode film, its sputtering target or its deposition. A value that belongs to another layer (a perovskite or organic absorber / active layer, a transport layer, a metal contact, the substrate) or to a whole device is not a value of this field, however well its name fits: leave it out.
prompt.sample_examples: (e.g. one per O2 flow rate, per power, per substrate temperature)
prompt.paper_level_rule: Target fields (group "target") describe the sputtering target and belong to the paper, not to a sample: put them under "target" only, never under a sample. `component` is the TARGET composition; a film's dopant concentration is not a component value. Use null for "target" only if the paper says nothing about the target.
prompt.no_samples_clause: the paper deposits no such film
prompt.no_samples_condition: the paper deposits no TCO or transparent-electrode film of its own (it only uses purchased ITO/FTO glass, say)
prompt.subset_examples: "all films deposited at 100 °C", "the annealed films", "the samples on glass"
prompt.partial_collective_example: "the sputtered films", when one listed sample is not sputtered
prompt.matching_justification_example: both are the 100 sccm O2 sample
prompt.implausible_origin: a different layer, process step or quantity

figures.subject: thin films (e.g. sputtered transparent conductive oxides)
figures.chart_definition: a film property (e.g. sheet resistance, resistivity, carrier concentration, mobility, thickness, average transmittance, figure of merit) plotted against a preparation or treatment condition (e.g. gas flow or ratio, power, pressure, temperature, thickness, doping level, sample name)
figures.axis_example: axis "Sheet resistance [10^2 ohm/sq]" with a marker at the "25" gridline => y = 25, unit "10^2 ohm/sq"

ui.no_samples_message_zh: 该论文没有自己沉积的 TCO 膜，所以没有样品级数据。

fields.name: component
fields.label: 靶材成分
fields.description: Chemical composition of the sputtering TARGET (not the film), e.g. 'SnO2:Ta (2 wt% Ta2O5)', 'ITO 90:10 wt%', 'Sn/Ta 95:5 wt%'.
fields.description_zh: 溅射靶材的化学组成；保留唯一组成文本，不拆选多个靶材。

fields.name: resistance
fields.label: 靶材电阻率
fields.description: Electrical resistivity of the sputtering target itself (not the film).
fields.description_zh: 靶材电阻率；与薄膜电阻率 resistivity 区分。

fields.name: density
fields.label: 靶材密度
fields.description: Relative density of the sputtering target as a percentage of theoretical density.
fields.description_zh: 靶材相对理论密度，数值 95 表示 95%。

fields.name: inch
fields.label: 靶材尺寸
fields.description: Size of the sputtering target: diameter, or length and width for a rectangular or rotary target.
fields.description_zh: 靶材直径或唯一长度；矩形长宽、范围值不转成单个数值。

fields.name: sputtering_time
fields.label: 溅射时间
fields.description: Duration of the sputtering deposition for this sample.
fields.description_zh: 所选样品的溅射沉积时间。

fields.name: sputtering_power
fields.label: 溅射功率
fields.description: Electrical power applied to the sputtering target to generate and sustain the plasma (W).
fields.description_zh: 所选样品的溅射功率（W）。

fields.name: mode
fields.label: 溅射模式
fields.description: Operational regime of the sputtering process: DC, RF or pulsed DC.
fields.description_zh: 溅射工作模式：DC、RF 或 pulsed DC。

fields.name: ar_flow_rate
fields.label: Ar 流量
fields.description: Argon flow rate into the chamber during sputter deposition of the film (sccm) -- never a flow used during annealing, venting or any post-treatment.
fields.description_zh: 所选样品的氩气流量（sccm）。

fields.name: o2_flow_rate
fields.label: O2 流量
fields.description: Oxygen flow rate into the chamber during sputter deposition of the film (sccm) -- never a flow used during annealing, venting or any post-treatment.
fields.description_zh: 所选样品的氧气流量（sccm）。

fields.name: h2_flow_rate
fields.label: H2 流量
fields.description: Hydrogen flow rate into the chamber during sputter deposition of the film (sccm) -- never a flow used during annealing, venting or any post-treatment.
fields.description_zh: 所选样品的氢气流量（sccm）。

fields.name: o2_ratio
fields.label: O2 比例
fields.description: Oxygen share of the SPUTTERING gas as the paper states it, O2/(Ar+O2) or O2/Ar (%). Record which of the two in `condition`. Never the gas of an annealing, forming-gas or other post-treatment step.
fields.description_zh: 溅射气体中氧气的比例（%），O2/(Ar+O2) 或 O2/Ar，具体口径见条件。

fields.name: h2_ratio
fields.label: H2 比例
fields.description: Hydrogen share of the SPUTTERING gas as the paper states it, H2/(Ar+H2) or H2/Ar (%). Record which of the two in `condition`. Never the gas of an annealing, forming-gas or other post-treatment step: forming gas H2/N2 15/85 used to anneal the film is not h2_ratio.
fields.description_zh: 溅射气体中氢气的比例（%），H2/(Ar+H2) 或 H2/Ar，具体口径见条件。

fields.name: working_pressure
fields.label: 工作气压
fields.description: Working (sputtering) pressure in the chamber during deposition (Pa) -- not the base pressure reached before it.
fields.description_zh: 沉积时腔体的工作气压（Pa），不是本底真空。

fields.name: target_substrate_distance
fields.label: 靶基距
fields.description: Spatial gap between the sputtering target and the substrate holder (cm).
fields.description_zh: 靶到基片/样品台的间距（cm）。

fields.name: substrate_axis_distance
fields.label: 基片偏轴距
fields.description: Lateral offset of the substrate from the holder's rotation axis or centre, i.e. the off-axis distance (cm). Never the target-to-substrate distance, which is target_substrate_distance.
fields.description_zh: 基片到样品台中心的偏轴距离（cm）。

fields.name: substrate_temperature
fields.label: 基片温度
fields.description: Substrate/holder temperature during the sputtering deposition (°C).
fields.description_zh: 沉积时的基片/样品台温度（°C）。

fields.name: annealing_temperature
fields.label: 退火温度
fields.description: Temperature of the thermal treatment of the TCO film performed after its deposition is complete (°C) -- not the annealing of an absorber, active or transport layer.
fields.description_zh: 沉积后退火处理的温度（°C）。

fields.name: annealing_time
fields.label: 退火时间
fields.description: Duration of the thermal treatment of the TCO film performed after its deposition is complete (min) -- not the annealing of an absorber, active or transport layer.
fields.description_zh: 沉积后退火处理的时长（min）。

fields.name: rotation_speed
fields.label: 转速
fields.description: Rotation speed of the substrate holder during sputter deposition of the film (rpm). The spin-coating speed of any layer is never a rotation speed.
fields.description_zh: 沉积时样品台的旋转速度（rpm）。

fields.name: sheet_resistance
fields.label: 方阻
fields.description: Sheet resistance of the film (Ω/sq).
fields.description_zh: 所选样品的薄膜方块电阻。

fields.name: resistivity
fields.label: 电阻率
fields.description: Electrical resistivity of the deposited film, as opposed to the `resistance` of the target it was sputtered from.
fields.description_zh: 所选样品的薄膜电阻率。

fields.name: transmittance
fields.label: 透光率
fields.description: Optical transmittance (%) of the transparent electrode or transparent conductive film -- not of a perovskite film, an absorber layer or a complete device. Always record the wavelength or range it refers to.
fields.description_zh: 所选样品的透光率，数值 85 表示 85%；测量波段见条件及数据质量。
fields.condition_hint: wavelength or spectral range, e.g. '550 nm' or 'average 400-800 nm'
fields.missing_condition_note_zh: 原文提取结果未注明透光率波长或波段

fields.name: thickness
fields.label: 厚度
fields.description: Thickness of the TCO / transparent-electrode film itself (e.g. from SEM cross section or profilometry) -- not of an absorber or active layer, a transport layer, the substrate or a whole device.
fields.description_zh: 所选样品的薄膜厚度。
